notes: 70 pages use authenticated role navigation; N01 and D08 use native authentication states. All 72 have code bindings; full functionality and acceptance remain separate.

Back-end HTTP GET /api/boss/ui/* routes return actual persisted selection data through BossPageAPI. Mutation actions use authenticated nanobot requestMutation, not browser-side SQLite or direct unauthenticated HTTP POST.

The role-scoped commands are boss.assignment.{create,send,complete,extend,cancel} and boss.simulation.feedback; each has its own server-side command whitelist, transaction, audit, version and idempotency receipt.
Task completion requires result submitted with currently valid evidence and a separate authenticated BOSS decision. Simulated feedback never marks completed.
Real Mac visual snapshots, actual DeepSeek+UI complete walkthrough and end-to-end E01-E06 remain not verified in this development slice.
T08 must replace all remaining semantic placeholders with real components, service operation IDs and event contracts before acceptance.
F24 and A15 use read-only, local metadata-only DeepSeek diagnostics; absence of response is explicit, no model success or cost is inferred from configuration.
All page bindings remain partial until their independent requirement and business checks complete; source coverage and metadata do not imply agricultural KPI completeness.

Agriculture pages only render verified source coverage and unknown KPIs: the selected water-feed sales note is not evidence for raw-material prices and does not support other sector metrics. All sector numeric KPIs are NULL and require new approved datasets.

Remaining action gaps, 561 visual states, end-to-end Mac/DeepSeek/voice/installation, source/metric completeness and pixel-accurate visual comparison are not accepted. Metadata-only page content does not satisfy PRD write or approval actions.

D03 and F30 are read-only runtime diagnostic views; A06 delegates to upstream Skills catalog; F31 renders the real evaluation definition but no actual score. None is accepted as an end-to-end PRD feature.

F27 records locally and requests the native authenticated transcribeAudio operation only after user action. Transcription remains disabled by default until a real STT provider is configured and tested; no success/e2e assertions are made.
F05 meeting minutes are versioned and grouped OPINION/SUGGESTION/DECISION/ASSIGNMENT_DRAFT; owner confirmed only after original source check. No assignment is auto-created or sent.

F07 application approvals must originate from explicit MAINTAINER simulated data in A03, with exact amount/currency and source version. REJECT/APPROVE/REQUEST_MORE are distinct. Revision after REQUEST_MORE invalidates old approvals; no financial transaction.
The redesigned Desktop v6 shell now follows source desktop layout geometry (64px topbar, 146/122px Hero, 204px sidebar, 278px right information column); macOS screenshot pixel diff remains NOT_RUN.

F08 now has versioned draft/save/simulated send/reply with actual SQLite records and owner consent; SENT_SIMULATED is distinct from external delivery and reply. Reply injection is a separate MAINTAINER action; it does not confirm task completion.

F12 owner-only private calendar edit/delete and busy-only scope sharing/revocation: title/location/body cannot enter the share object; private content is not readable through maintenance API. No actual external invite is sent.

Functional priority patch: F05/F06/F07/F08/F12/F13/N06/N07/N08/A04 can re-query a persisted original idempotency receipt after uncertain WebSocket responses; absence is NOT proof of failed delivery. No datasets added.

FR12 calendar-conflict reads the same authoritative single-meeting conflict classification used by calendar.save; missing meeting end remains unknown. Busy shares are ineffective after expiry, revoke or calendar-version change; owner preview only, no recipient account or external delivery.

F08 cannot send a message linked to an OPEN assignment before separate owner-authorized assignment send; contact ID validity is checked against current simulated clock and duplicate attachments are rejected.

FR04 owner-authenticated meeting briefing preparation is versioned in real SQLite with deterministic metric aggregation and source state; any document/participant/task/event change can yield NEEDS_REVIEW without rewriting old snapshots. Missing-material requests become F08 DRAFT only, never SENT.

FR05 confirmed minute ASSIGNMENT_DRAFT can be separately authorized into ONE OPEN FR06 task with original minute version, entry ID and document version, using existing Store.create_assignment inside BEGIN IMMEDIATE. F05 and F06 read live link/task status; send remains a distinct owner action. Not a production external delivery.

F06 task page now reads a unified actual SQLite link timeline for independently approved F06 assignment outbox messages and F08 follow-up messages, with separate send/delivery/reply statuses; no external delivery success is assumed.

F09 is an owner-scoped versioned research draft with exact quote/source-id/offset and publication cutoff. Missing causality/model inference/country relation remains explicitly unknown. No simulated source converted into verified factual claim. No public-web/semantic ingestion and no Mac pixel acceptance.

A07 technical knowledge lifecycle: explicit SIMULATED source create/revise/withdraw with CAS and SQLite FTS indexing. MAINTAINER only sees metadata; BOSS F09 sees approved, current text. External crawling and multi-format ingestion remain pending.

FR05->FR06 confirmed minute entry link is independently authorized and creates exactly one OPEN task per entry/version; sending still requires separate BOSS action. Latest creation/sending validates coordinator validity against actual simulation clock.

A05 now renders real versioned Prompt save/structure validation/activation/deactivation and MAINTAINER-only runtime context loading metadata; activation alone does not prove a DeepSeek call or evaluation quality. Technical guidance cannot modify BOSS permissions.

N05 now renders source Desktop v6 tab/filter/five-column task center, using current simulated business clock and persisted task/feedback/source/due-event records; actions lead to F06 owner confirmation. Browser screenshot and acceptance still NOT_RUN.

F04/F06 newly persisted material and follow-up draft IDs are carried only in authenticated React state to F08 for review; this does not send automatically, disclose to MAINTAINER, or bypass source/version/owner validations.

FR06 owner-confirmed task nudge is a separate write after initial authorized send, with stable contact, current source pins, 24h simulated business-clock cooldown, and a metadata-only linked message in F06/N05. No external delivery or task completion is inferred.

N05 owner-only self commitments now have real CAS/idempotent create, evidence-confirmed completion, extension, cancellation and persisted due events, separate from F06 assignment to contacts. Source/current evidence withdrawal yields NEEDS_REVIEW; no real external notifications.
F06 now has an independently owner-authorized simulated nudge; it does not update deadline or certify external delivery, and nudge events remain auditable.

A13 now supports role-restricted, versioned technical scheduler draft/save/validate/activate/pause/resume/cancel with idempotent SQLite audit and no BOSS authorization. Manual run, real CronService runtime restart, and macOS lifecycle remain unverified.

A13 can manually dispatch ONE approved versioned simulated event using the same canonical ControlStore.dispatch_due_in_transaction logic as CronService; local delivery/duplicate/quiet/plan suppressions are real SQLite outcomes. External/system notification and Mac restart still not verified.

F11 Travel now has owner-only SQLite review/confirm/cancel, deterministic IANA offset/time checks, version-pinned conflict confirmation, and F04 live meeting-impact invalidation; no real transport/calendar booking or target Mac pixel acceptance.

F10 People meeting has stable-ID verified owner preparation, current role, task/feedback provenance, source-version redaction, confirmed attach/detach to current simulated meeting agenda and F04 freshness invalidation; no real employee account, invitation or calendar update.

N07 owner goals, N08 notification preferences and F26 settings hub are now separate v6 React components. Drafts cannot take effect without BOSS-only second CAS confirmation. Runtime context load observations are not model compliance, and confirmed owner notification policy only adds suppressions to existing CronService rules. Real Mac/visual acceptance remains NOT_RUN.

N10 now performs BOSS-only future authorization revocation with CAS/idempotent transaction, explicit reason digest, original authorization version, and owner-scoped metadata. Historical actions cannot be recalled; target Mac E2E/visual remains unverified.
